Read from published copies (https://www.ramco.com/hubfs/DT%20notification-28-2023.pdf, https://mspa.in/detail/52866.aspx) because incometaxindia.gov.in refused the request. For tax years up to 2025-26 (April 2025 - March 2026). Read on 18 November 2026.

The form text was read from copies published by others (the tax department's site refused the request). Rows 13 to 17 (tax on income, rebate, surcharge, cess) are filled only from pay items HR puts on them: Payobook does not work tax out again. Row 10(d) is not capped. Row 2(g) is shown as one total (2(h)).

Quarterly salary tax statement figures — Form 24Q (quarters up to March 2026)
Form No. 24Q — Quarterly statement of deduction of tax under sub-section (3) of section 200 in respect of salary
Figures for your return preparer: the upload file itself is made with the tax department's own utility.

Income-tax Rules 1962, Form No. 24Q as substituted by Notification 99/2021 (G.S.R. 612(E), 2 September 2021), Annexure I columns 314-329 and Annexure II columns 330-390 (as amended by Notifications 28/2023 and 112/2024). Read from published copies (https://www.cainindia.org/news/9_2021/incometax_26th_amendment_rules_2021.html). For quarters up to January - March 2026. Read on 18 November 2026.

Date of payment and date of deduction are the last day of each payslip period. Challan, deposit and section code columns are left for the return preparer. Deductee type is worked out from the date of birth.
